result.edit: The failure occurs at cycle 11 when the module is in state sf6 and incorrectly outputs match=0, not_match=1 (01) when it should output 00. The issue is in the sf6 state transition logic where it incorrectly transitions based on data input. According to the specification, after completing a group (6 bits), the module should reset to idle state to begin checking the next group. Changing the sf6 transition to always go to idle fixes this issue.
